en.text: They took out the Pigeon Lady!
This isn't going to end well for them…
They took out the Chess Guy!
She moved them out of position!
They took out the Test Pilot!
I can't believe I'm working with him…
I knew I could count on you.
I'll be back when I can McGinnis
I like the way you think, McGinnis.
They didn't even have a chance.
They didn't realize they were walking into a trap.
I can still smell the ozone…
Do you what you have to do Seven
The Baxter Society could use someone like you, Haze.
I don't know if I could have made that shot.
I'll help when I can Vindicta
It's an honor to work with you, Infernus.
How I've missed the children of Ixia.
This was the first of many victories.
I thought I was really in trouble for a minute.
I see why Lash has his ego.
They really need to stop bickering with each other...
Billy's going to go get himself killed isn't he…
They took out the Rat King!
You're a credit to the Baxter Society
The Baxter Society is lucky to have you, Shiv.
You'll do the Baxter society well, Shiv.
I see why you're beloved, Ivy.
So this is the cube I've heard so much about…
I hope that thing knows what it's doing
Fight to the bitter end Warden
I'll come back when I can Wraith
I've come too far to fail now!
I won't stop until every one of them is dead!
We should have seen that coming!
How could we have been so stupid!
It might be time to invest in my abilities.
Just because I don’t see them, doesn't mean they aren't here…
It's time for discretion, not valor…
I need to find a place to rest.
I need to stop cutting it so close…
If we're not careful this could end in disaster…
We're in trouble, but this isn't over…
Have faith… we haven't lost yet.
I won't be remembered as a failure…
What have I gotten myself into…
It would appear that I misjudged them…
The stakes are too high, I must remain calm…
I've survived certain death before… I can do it again.
Together we can do great things.
One arrow is all it takes…
Just need a little more time….
It's not too late to trap them…
It's always satisfying taking someone off their pedestal.
You can't run from me, Sheriff.
I didn't expect her to be a coward.
Word of advice: never make yourself a stationary target.
All you did was throw your life away, Bebop.
I thought automatons were supposed to be clever.
The fox can only outrun the hunter for so long.
You picked the wrong man to toy with.
Keep your eye on the professor!
How many turrets does that woman have?
I'll tear through your machines to get to you, McGinnis!
They're going to try to put the pressure on us.
Geist is ready to steal your health.
You can't hide from me, Haze.
You're not a predator. Just a target.
At least you made me work for it, Kelvin.
Thanks for making me smile, Lash.
I haven't smiled in a while…
I haven't felt hope in a long time…
We keep this up, the battle will be over soon..
We need to keep the pressure on!
The prey is around here somewhere….
I'll kill as many of them as I have to…
I won't let the law stand in my way.
No one is safe from me.
Go back home while you still can, Holliday.
I wish there was another way.
Any other day and we could have been allies.
You gave me no choice, Abrams.
I won't be denied by a machine.
I won't let you stop me, Bebop.
She won't be shielding her allies anymore.
Not all stories have happy endings…
This isn't the place for you, Paige.
You're in over your head, kid.
I have no time for games, Paradox.
I won't be stopped by the likes of you, Paradox.
Paradox, all you did was delay the inevitable.
The Baroness is backing the wrong Patron, Doorman.
Return to The Baroness while you still can.
You should never have left the hotel, Doorman.
I wasn't expecting to see the Drifter here, but I'm glad he showed up to get what was coming to him.
I won't let you ruin any more lives, Drifter.
You're not ready for this fight, Professor.
He belongs in the classroom, not the battlefield.
You have spirit, Dynamo, but spirit isn't enough.
Your wife needs you alive, Dynamo. Stop this madness.
Well, at least I don't have much longer to live with the guilt.
This isn't how I wanted things to go, Apollo.
You're on the wrong side, Apollo.
My daughter in-law would be so disappointed.
Your machines will never stop me.
Your little war toys will never be enough.
That woman is proving to be a problem.
I won't let you get in my way, Victor.
Corpses are such a pain in the ass to kill.
I wish you luck in your search, but you're not winning today.
I have no patience for those who prey on others.
I dedicated my life to killing things like you, Seven.
You may have outsmarted the law, but you'll never outsmart me.
Men like you are as predictable as they are cliché, Seven.
Justice doesn't come swiftly. But it always comes for people like you.
I won't let the government get in my way.
I didn't want to fight the OSIC, but I'll do what I must.
Your dream walking days are over, Haze.
And you thought you were the Apex Predator…
Why did you turn on me, Vindicta?
I thought we wanted the same thing, Vindicta.
I didn't want to do this, Vindicta.
I thought she was my friend.
Only one of us gets vengeance today.
I wished there was another way.
I didn't want to spill more Ixian blood.
Why are you helping them, Infernus?
Infernus won't be bothering us for a while.
The dead belong in the ground.
Kelvin: I'll give you the peace you seek.
Quit while you still can, Kelvin.
There is no mercy for you today, Kelvin.
I can't let you get in my way, Krill.
Your hubris got you killed, Lash.
I tire of your games, Lash.
The Djinn are on the wrong side today.
I was content to leave you alone, Calico, why did you have to come here?
I wish it didn't have to be this way.
She gave up on her ideals for something as pointless as money.
I don't want to fight you, Calico.
Get out of my way, Graves.
You're not using that lich hand, Graves, it's using you.
The dead aren't things to toy with.
Wish the Venator was fighting for us…
I've seen a few Venators in my time, that one was angrier than most…
So much for a friendly rivalry…
One day you'll learn what real anger feels like, Billy.
You're not a rebel, Billy, you're just an asshole.
And here I thought you could replace me, Shiv.
It seems I chose my replacement poorly.
Even the Baxter Society turns its back on me?
In time you'll be great. But that day isn't today.
You still have much to learn, Shiv.
How many lives must I take for this madness to end?
You won't find your destiny here, Pocket, only death.
You were a noble woman, Ivy.
I took no pleasure in that, Ivy.
You have a good heart, Ivy, but good hearts don’t win wars.
She was just doing what she thought was right.
Oh the misplaced arrogance of youth.
Young vampires are always the stupidest.
I'm not as frail as I look, Vyper.
You prey on the weak, Vyper, and I won't stand for it.
Should have stayed in jail, Vyper.
That goo thing never had a chance against me.
The world isn't black and white, Warden.
Your obsession will be your undoing, Warden.
You always were a pain in the ass, Silver.
Stay out of my business, Lilah.
You picked the wrong time to choose a side.
Greed got the best of you, Wraith.
You're not half as clever as you think you are, Wraith.
You never had a chance against me, Wraith.
I'll always make time to kill men like you Wrecker
Return to whatever abyss you crawled out of
Fairfax was a fool to think he could control you
I'm sorry that you failed your brother.
Yamato is no longer a threat.
She'll be looking for revenge soon.
Today is a day for bloody retribution.
The death I bring today is nothing compared to what lies in store for Hathorne.
How much blood must I bathe in before you give up?
New York is my hunting grounds…
You will drown in the blood of your allies.
I'm not afraid to die. Are you?
Walk away while you still have the chance.
No one will stand between me and my revenge.
I don't have the luxury of mercy today.
They will fall one. By. One.
I have enough arrows for all of you…
And once again, I am alone.
I'll hold on as long as I can…
I can't let them fight my battle.
It's time to complete the ritual.
What do you want from The Patron?
Looks like we have something in common.
Can I give you an unsolicited word of advice Holliday?

People are going to tell you that there is a difference between justice and revenge, that you will dishonor the dead by stooping to their killer's level…ignore them. Revenge isn't for the dead. It's for the living.
My son. My daughter in law. My... my grandkids.
Yeah. They're also gonna have arrows through their necks.
You remind me of my step daughter.
Don't worry Abrams… I'm not dying until I have my revenge.
I've never worked with a golem before.
Now I feel like an asshole.
I was one of the founding members.
I do. Some of them even have happy endings.
You remind me of my daughter in law.
Your parents know you're doing this.
It's not too late to go home.
I'll do what I can to protect you.
It's not throwing it away if they die.
How are things at The Baroness?
The Baroness still the most haunted hotel in America?
A lot more than most. You endured something horrible and yet you live your life like it's going to be ok.
I wish I could be like you.
Have you been to Ixia professor?
I don't think so, but thank you for the offer.
Whose dream did you come from?
I don't need words. I need your sword.
What would your father say if he saw you now?
I don't. My um. My daughter in law followed all the royal gossip.
I'm sure. None the less, I can't imagine he would approve of what you're doing.
I don't know what you're talking about.
Anyone could have locked them inside and lit the building on fire.
What can I say. We live in strange times.
I see charm is not one of your talents.
I'm old, of course I'm hurting.
I'll support you the best that I can, but I probably won't be charging in with you.
It used to be literal. Then I retired. Now it's more figurative.
That ward on your arm. It's impressive.
I'm sure the Baxter Society would love to speak to whoever designed it.
You were a fool to make a deal with that thing.
If you were I doubt you'd be risking your life right now.
You know, you're lucky. If The Baxter Society knew about your arrangement with Oathkeeper they probably would have put you in the ground.
If I was still in the Baxter Society they would probably ask me to hunt you down.
Today demands a level of brutality that few are capable of
Thank you. We… we got your card.
Let's be honest Haze, this was the only circumstance we'd have a reunion.
I'm retired. I don't need their permission.
I care what they think. But it doesn't change what I have to do.
You don't know me. You don't know my family. And I'm willing to bet you don't know what real loss feels like. So kindly keep your dime store platitudes to yourself.
Trap them in your ice dome and leave the rest to me.
Today you create a killing floor for me, do you understand?
I built it's name. And the reputation of monster hunters is the least of my concern.
If we fail today, can you help me track someone down?
I was feeling better before you started talking.
Your delusions of grandeur are impressive
I do. You're prowess is undeniable.
You'd begin your career with a string of modest successes, each one throwing logs on the fire of self confidence.

Then you'd start taking more dangerous work. Work that you feel only you could handle. Your unorthodox tactics work 100% of the time. Until they don't. And then your brothers find your skinless corpse in a retention pond in Portugal or Denmark. It's always Portugal or Denmark.
If we're going to win we need to learn to work together.
This is going to be goddamn nightmare.
With murder yes, but there is nothing petty about it.
I wasted a lot of time building that legend.
It's not, but I should've stepped down sooner than I did.
Mirage, can I give you a word of advice?
Duty is a trap. You think it fills you, gives you purpose, but all it does is steal time from a life you won't realized passed you by until it's too late.
We both know that's a lie.
I understand. You being here now means more.
How awkward do you want to make it.
I don't have many breaths left, Calico… I'm certainly not going to waste them on your problems.
Can you speak to the dead?
It's not. But… but afterwards. If we survive… would you mind talking to someone for me.
How long have you had that hand?
Just trying to figure out how much time you have left.
One day you're going to realize who I am and know how stupid you sound right now.
This has nothing to do with The Society.
I'm not in the mood for games Paradox.
The only thing I expect from Paradox is style over substance.
It is. And we won't squander it.
The society still giving you problems.
Stay with it. They'll come around.
They will. It was never going to easy for you Shiv. But I promise you it'll be worth it.
No, I'm here for my own reasons. Glad you're here though, no one else I'd rather fight with.
Okay, top eight but I really do mean it.
Don't try to guilt me Shiv. Not today.
No. Justice is for children who don't know how the world works.
You're not a talker are you?
The suitcase is a little on the nose for a kid wearing daddy's jacket to work, don't you think.
Thank you for the offer Viscous. I'm fine.
If we fail to summon the Patron we'll probably be dead.
*sigh* bring them my bow, they'll listen to what you have to say.
Be honest with me: is this the life you would have chosen for yourself?
Yeah. Well the others probably will get to enjoy a meaningful retirement.
Warden. We're the ones with hollow lives.
I'll do what I can to support you when you charge in. You may not always see me, but don't wo-
I'm not in the mood to chit chat.
If that's all they're saying, I'm far more dangerous.
First we isolate them. Then we put them in the ground.
Worry about the task at hand, Venator.
How are things with the Venators?
Hope you haven't had too many funerals.
The patron doesn't hate you. I do.
You don't know what you're talking about.
You being a moron has nothing to do with me starting the Baxter Society
I think the fact that I didn't turn my head into a goat makes me better than you.
You want to act like a jackass that’s your business, but you don’t get to be indignant when I point it out. Now shut up and try not to die.
Today, kindness and mercy are just liabilities.
They won't be. But maybe the world will be a little better.
I'm a long ways away from the hero I once was.
I'm not talking about my age.
You're holding a baton, and you're critiquing me?
I know you seek to usurp Simon. Don't do it.

You don't really want to be Viscount. You want the power that comes with the title. So just wish for fame or money or some other thing that you think will give you a fabulous life with zero responsibility, and don’t disrupt the entire Barony of New York.
I'm assuming that's not a compliment.
Ah, I see. The joke is that I'm old. You're very clever Mina, truly the brightest mind of a generation.
I'm not looking to chit chat.
I haven't missed your charm, Silver.
I don’t owe you an explanation.
It's nice that we understand each other.
A sword and a bow… aren't we the icons of the modern world.
They won't get lucky next time…
This might not be the right time to engage.
I can't help anyone if I throw my life away….
You stirred something in me that was best left sleeping…
My revenge isn't denied… it's just deferred.
Victory is slipping through my fingers…
This isn't how it was supposed to happen…
I tried, but it wasn't enough.
I shouldn't leave those souls lying around.
I need to pick up those souls.
I won't be lectured on morality.
My story is not over yet…
I thought I had earned a peaceful life…
This will be a hunt to remember…
I can't replace what was taken from me. But I can make them answer for it.
I should check out the store…
It might be time to get an item…
I wonder what else I can buy?
I should see what I can afford now…
Perhaps I should spend what I have.
It might be time to use these souls…
I can get something of quality.
There must be something I can buy.
If I want to summon the Patron, I need to be well equipped.
It's time to go back to the curiosity shoppe.
We'll summon the patrons soon enough.
Soon the ritual will be complete…
We took the objective, that's what matters.
The ritual is one step closer to being complete…
Don't have time for the Patrons today... I have some bodies to hide.
I… I still need time to mourn.
I need to investigate some things.
I have to go on a stake out…
Can't. There's a Friends of Humanity safe house I need to burn down.
I'm not ready to summon the Patrons.
I won't let my family down.
Ahhh the thrill of the hunt.
I've missed being on the hunt…
I'm ready to hunt larger game…
There's no man or beast I can't bring down.
I will find their trail… and I will end them.
They'll be dead before they know it.
They won't catch me flat footed.
I must be as mobile as my prey.
I won't let them catch me…
Need to use these buildings to my advantage…
I can't stay on the ground forever…
I must keep my wits about me…
They won't get the drop on me.
They'll walk right into my trap.
Snares have changed over the years, haven't they…
Soon I will spring the trap…
Outwitting our enemy shouldn't be too hard.
They won't find me to be easy prey.
I'll lure them into my trap.
They will have no place to hide.
The hunt is about to get more interesting.
I don't have to be the fastest… just the most clever.
Their spirits will guide my hand.
I will not be denied my revenge.
No one can hide from me.
They will learn what it means to be hunted…
I am not alone on this hunt… the spirits join with me.
I will find them… no matter where they run to.
I can call on the spirits again…
Fire on me all you want…
If I stay on the ground, I'm dead…
If they come, I'll be ready.
Let' see what you catch, my friend…
They won't know what hit them…
Let them run, it will not save them.
Let's take out the Pigeon Lady.
Let's take out the Chess Player.
Let's take out the Test Pilot.
Let's take out the Rat King.
Check out what The Doorman bought.
I'm not ready for a team fight
Maybe now I can find peace.
All roads led to this moment.
Time to make my demand of the Patron.
I couldn't have done this without your help.
The hunt is about to begin.
I hope you all have the will to do what needs to be done.
We don't have the luxury of failure today.
Today my grandkids will be paid in blood.
I will do whatever it takes to complete the ritual.
I'll find them wherever they hide…
I'll find them from a lane away…
Ready to give long range support.
